name: Lydon's Toxin
summary: Lydon's Toxin is an alchemical concoction synthesized by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill to disrupt the Venture Company's deforestation in the Stonetalon Mountains. Entrusted to Horde adventurers, it is delivered to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff so she can devise an effective delivery mechanism.

sections.title: A Royal Apothecary Solution
sections.body: Developed by Apothecary Lydon in the Hillsbrad Foothills, this virulent compound is designed to combat the invasive Venture Company loggers despoiling the Stonetalon Mountains. According to Lydon, the concoction produces lethal and potentially contagious results upon contact. However, before the substance can be unleashed against the goblins' operations around the Windshear Crag, it must be ferried across continents to Apothecary Zamah, the Royal Apothecary Society's representative in Thunder Bluff. Zamah requires the raw mixture to engineer a wide-dispersal apparatus—the Toxic Fogger—ensuring the brew wipes out the exploitative deforesters without needlessly endangering Horde assets.

faq.q: What is Lydon's Toxin used for?
faq.answer: The toxin was concocted by Apothecary Lydon to break the Venture Company's grip on the Windshear Crag region. It is engineered to be devastating and potentially contagious against the destructive goblin laborers.

Apothecary Lydon is a member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. He specializes in the creation of virulent poisons and experimental compounds to further Forsaken objectives.

faq.q: Why does the toxin need to go to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: While Lydon perfected the chemical mixture, it lacks a practical method of mass deployment. Apothecary Zamah resides on the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff to study regional flora and coordinate Society efforts in Kalimdor; she takes the toxin to adapt it into a portable fogging delivery system.

faq.q: What happens after Zamah receives the toxin?
aliases: what does zamah do with the toxin
faq.answer: Upon receiving the phial, Apothecary Zamah processes the agent into a pressurized aerosol device called the Toxic Fogger, allowing an operative to disperse it through the heart of the Venture Company's encampment.

angles.text: The transport of Lydon's Toxin exemplifies the Royal Apothecary Society's far-reaching network, coordinating field research between Lordaeron and Kalimdor to demonstrate Forsaken utility to their allies.
While the tauren welcome aid against the Venture Company's destruction of nature, the Royal Apothecary Society's chemical methods test the boundaries of their shamanic sensibilities.
